title: ruscus procerus
intro: Ruscus procerus, commonly known as Ruscus, is a type of flowering plant in the family Arum. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in promoting circulation and reducing inflammation. The health benefits of Ruscus include its ability to help reduce swelling and alleviate symptoms of varicose veins and edema, due to its therapeutic actions of promoting venous tone and improving circulation. The bioactive constituents of Ruscus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects and may help to reduce blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health.
